career.description: Formulate and execute comprehensive Strategic Sales plans and quotas for the Bahrain market, ensuring strict alignment with corporate management objectives. Lead and mentor sales teams, setting clear targets and monitoring performance to ensure sales goals are consistently met or exceeded. Secure high-value deals with public and private sectors by actively managing bids on the Bahrain Tender Board and Procural (Tenders & Auctions Platform). Oversee the end-to-end Vendor Management process, obtaining and maintaining industrial vendor pre-qualifications with key government and private entities. Identify and pursue public and private Government Tenders, managing the submission process to ensure compliance and competitiveness. Cultivate robust relationships with key accounts and expand the customer base by identifying and counseling district sales representatives. Conduct regular client visits to diagnose evolving needs, assess relationship quality, and negotiate pricing to close and renew orders. Establish and nurture critical relationships with Civil Defense and government ministries to facilitate smooth project execution and compliance. Monitor key economic indicators, emerging market trends, and supply and demand shifts to optimize product mix and sales volume. Recommend new product lines and service improvements based on comprehensive market analysis and consumer needs surveys. Maintain technical expertise by participating in professional networks and reviewing industry publications to stay ahead of the curve.
